bouquetNotes: Lucky to share life with you
maya-28.headline: Twenty-Eight Years of Brightening Every Room
maya-28.message:
Happy 28th birthday, Maya!

Some friendships feel effortless from day one, and ours has been built on the best kind of everyday magic—midnight taco runs after ceramics class, getting soaked at the jazz festival and laughing the whole walk home, and never once regretting ordering two desserts for the table.

Thank you for showing up with warmth, humor, and genuine care. No matter where this year takes you, know you are endlessly celebrated.
maya-28.toastQuote: To two desserts for the table and zero regrets.

notes.message: Still thinking about how you convinced us to adopt a sourdough starter during finals week. Wishing you the happiest 28th!
Nobody centers a stoneware bowl—or a chaotic Monday morning—quite like you. Save a slice of cake for the studio!
May your year ahead be packed with sunny patios, spontaneous road trips, and coffee that never goes cold.
